Fixture provenance
==================

resources/ical/*.ics and resources/vcard/*.vcf are round-trip fixtures collected
from public sources. The *.ics.out, *.vcf.out and *.json files next to them are
regenerated on every test run and are not golden files.

biweekly
  https://github.com/mangstadt/biweekly
  ical:  366.ics..367.ics 369.ics 371.ics..372.ics 374.ics 376.ics..386.ics

CalDAVTester
  https://github.com/CalConnect/caldavtester
  ical:  387.ics..397.ics
  vcard: 106.vcf..156.vcf 239.vcf..240.vcf

Calendar and Contacts Server
  https://github.com/apple/ccs-calendarserver
  ical:  426.ics..469.ics 936.ics..937.ics 948.ics 963.ics 972.ics 976.ics
         979.ics 983.ics
  vcard: 157.vcf..158.vcf
